content:
[Intro]
[E5]

[Verse 1]
My skin is cold
Transfusion with
somebody
Morose and old
Drop into fruit
less dying

[Verse 2]
It was tempting and bared
The whoring angel
rising
Now burning prayers
My silent time
of losing

[Chorus]
[D5]
My foes
they can't destroy
my body
Colliding slow
like life it-

[Intro]
[E5]self

[Verse 3]
Long for the blur
We cannot dry
much longer
Cement to dirt
Disgusted with my
cheapness

[Chorus]
[D5]
My foes
they can't destroy
my body
Colliding slow,
like life itself
My foes,
they can't destroy
my body
Colliding slow,
like life it-

[Interlude]
[F7M/A]self
Reaching down
Staring up
at the forgiver

[Solo]

[Bridge]

[Chorus]
[D5]
My foes
they can't destroy
my body
Colliding slow,
like life itself
My foes,
they can't destroy
my body
Colliding slow,
like life it-
self
